decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates under the ACT umbrella fit the growing glass-core packaging trend and Plan Optik's core wafer competence. The product is still mentioned in 2024, so management has not yet seen a clear shortfall against its aspirations, and given the small firm's limited slack it is likely to keep it as part of its connectivity portfolio rather than start problemistic search.

VLIS was only launched in 2024 and has a dedicated page aimed at the hot through-glass-via market. Early uncertain results would be measured against long-horizon aspirations tied to the semiconductor packaging boom, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
